描述_EN: A white-glazed, floral and chrysanthemum-wrapped jar at Danyangyu kiln，the Song dynasty (960-1279)，your (honorific)34.5centimetre，caliber16centimetre，footsteps12.6centimetre。 　　floral decoration，From the mouth to the lower part of the abdomen5tiered motif，Leaf pattern in order、stripe、twining peony、stripe、decorative pattern。　　This jar is brightly colored，high contrast，Vivid and colorful decorations。　　The practice of picking porcelain is to first apply a layer of white cosmetic clay on the gray-brown tire，mark out a pattern，Then pick off the white make-up from the ground outside the pattern.，Exposure of gray-brown tires，Creates a decorative effect of a dark ground against a white pattern.。the Song dynasty (960-1279)、Golden Age，Shanxi Province in the north of China、anhui、He'nan Mengguzu autonomous county in Qinghai、Inner Mongolia、Some porcelain kilns in Ningxia，In order to solve the disadvantages of porcelain production caused by the lack of pure raw materials for local porcelain production，Create an alternative decorative groove，Utilizing the covering power of makeup clay or black glaze，大量采用白釉或黑釉floral decoration，Formation of a new decorative style，其中以He'nan Mengguzu autonomous county in Qinghai当阳峪窑的产品最受人称道。
描述_ZN: Dangli Lishe Stele, Western Jin Dynasty, surviving 70 cm in height and 64 cm in width.    The inscription is in official script. The inscription inscribed in the yang of the stele has 15 lines of 147 characters, the content of which is the reason for the establishment of the society, and the text is mostly eroded. The 24 lines of 295 characters inscribed on the shade of the tablet are the inscriptions of the inscribers, with 8 people sitting in the conical portrait of the crown, 4 people in each of the two lines above and below, and the place of origin, official position, and name of the presiding officer of Dangli Li, such as She Lao, She Zheng, She Puisne, and She Shi. From the name of the person who erected the monument, it can be seen that the people who lived in Dangli-ri at that time were of different origins, but they were all those with middle and lower level positions. This monument was erected when the residents of Dangli-li established a shrine of the nature of praying for the annual report, and is an important inscription for the study of the organization and inscriptions of the community at that time. This monument is said to have been unearthed in Luoyang, Henan Province.
